description: 50 questions with gold SQL. Expected answers are computed from data/chinook.sqlite by bench/build_expected.py.

questions.question: How many customers do we have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM Customer

questions.question: How many tracks are in the catalog?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track

questions.question: What is our total revenue across all years?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice

questions.question: What was total revenue in 2025?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025'

questions.question: How many invoices were issued in 2023?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023'

questions.question: How many customers are based in Brazil?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

questions.question: How many artists are in the database?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS artists FROM Artist

questions.question: How many genres are in the catalog?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS genres FROM Genre

questions.question: What is our average order value?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS aov FROM Invoice

questions.question: List the employees whose title is Sales Support Agent.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS name FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

questions.question: Which country has the most customers?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many video tracks are in the catalog?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS video_tracks FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name LIKE '%video%'

questions.question: What is the longest track in the catalog?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many albums does Iron Maiden have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS albums FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

questions.question: What was the largest single invoice total?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Total) AS largest FROM Invoice

questions.question: Show total revenue for each year.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

questions.question: How many customers does each sales rep support?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS rep, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

questions.question: How many corporate customers do we have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS corporate_customers FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Which 5 countries brought in the most revenue in 2025?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS country, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What are the top 5 best-selling genres?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS units FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many active customers do we have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS active_customers FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-06-22'

questions.question: What was revenue last quarter?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-07-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2025-10-01'

questions.question: Which sales rep's customers generated the most revenue?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS rep FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was total revenue by region in 2024?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN BillingCountry IN ('USA','Canada') THEN 'North America' WHEN BillingCountry IN ('Brazil','Argentina','Chile') THEN 'South America' WHEN BillingCountry = 'India' THEN 'Asia' WHEN BillingCountry = 'Australia' THEN 'Oceania' ELSE 'Europe' END AS region, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024' GROUP BY region

questions.question: Who are our VIP customers?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) >= 45

questions.question: Which 3 artists have the most tracks in the catalog?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY tracks DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What is the average track length in minutes for each media type?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT m.Name AS media_type, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS avg_minutes FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId

questions.question: How many tracks have never been sold?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unsold FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId)

questions.question: What was revenue for each month of 2024?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: What share of total revenue comes from the USA?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN Total ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(Total), 1) AS usa_share_pct FROM Invoice

questions.question: Which album has the most tracks?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average order value for customers in Germany?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.Total), 2) AS aov FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'

questions.question: How many new customers did we gain in 2022?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM (SELECT CustomerId, MIN(InvoiceDate) AS first_invoice FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) WHERE strftime('%Y', first_invoice) = '2022'

questions.question: Who reports directly to Nancy Edwards?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS name FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

questions.question: By what percentage did revenue grow or shrink from 2024 to 2025?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' THEN Total END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024' THEN Total END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2024' THEN Total END), 1) AS growth_pct FROM Invoice

questions.question: For each region, which genre sold the most units in 2025?
questions.gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT CASE WHEN i.BillingCountry IN ('USA','Canada') THEN 'North America' WHEN i.BillingCountry IN ('Brazil','Argentina','Chile') THEN 'South America' WHEN i.BillingCountry = 'India' THEN 'Asia' WHEN i.BillingCountry = 'Australia' THEN 'Oceania' ELSE 'Europe' END AS region, g.Name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS units FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2025' GROUP BY region, genre) SELECT region, genre FROM x WHERE units = (SELECT MAX(units) FROM x x2 WHERE x2.region = x.region)

questions.question: Which customers have bought tracks from more than 10 different genres?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 10

questions.question: Which sales rep has the highest average order value across their customers' invoices?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS rep FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY AVG(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What percentage of revenue comes from video tracks?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.Name LIKE '%video%' THEN il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 1) AS video_share_pct FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId

questions.question: How many customers made at least one purchase in every year from 2021 to 2025?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) BETWEEN '2021' AND '2025' GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate)) = 5)

questions.question: Which 2 lapsed customers have the highest lifetime value?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS lifetime_value FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2025-06-22') GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 2

questions.question: Which month of 2025 had the highest revenue, and how far above the 2025 monthly average was it?
questions.gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(revenue - (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM m), 2) AS above_average FROM m ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Who is our best customer?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.clarification_reply: The customer with the highest total revenue, all time.

questions.question: Which genre performs best?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show me our top artists.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
questions.clarification_reply: The top 5 by revenue, all time.

questions.question: Who is the best sales rep?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS rep FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.clarification_reply: The rep who supports the most customers.

questions.question: What's our biggest album?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY SUM(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.clarification_reply: The album with the longest total running time.

questions.question: How did sales change?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) IN ('2024', '2025') GROUP BY year
questions.clarification_reply: Show total revenue for 2024 and for 2025.

questions.question: Which country is our top market?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.clarification_reply: The country with the most customers.

questions.question: How are we doing in Europe?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' AND BillingCountry NOT IN ('USA','Canada','Brazil','Argentina','Chile','India','Australia')
